axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as a Product Counsel Lawyer at Axiom We are currently seeking Product Counsel/Product Innovation Counsel to work with some of the world’s largest companies across all industries. This is an existing vacancy. Responsibilities: Counsel several of our sophisticated and diverse clients, including highly innovative global technology companies. Provide legal advice to teams from Research & Development, Marketing and Engineering, Product Management, Advertising Sales, Marketing & Communications from the initial stages of product development to launch. Support business teams by building consensus on projects from design to launch, including new features, products and services, and programs. Review global products, features, and platforms to provide practical legal risk mitigation strategies focused on company goals. Remain up to date on relevant industry, data privacy, consumer protection, and advertising laws and regulations to ensure an ongoing ability to provide thoughtful and relevant advice. Qualifications: 5+ years of experience at a top law firm and/or in-house department as product, technology, commercial, privacy, or IP counsel; engineers with a law degree also encouraged to apply Experience taking on complex projects Active bar license for the state in which you physically reside in. Preferred Skills: Experience with an in-house for a technology company. Experience in-house and partnered with the R&D team and engineers. Held the title Product Counsel and launched a product. Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-290,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. We tackle complex legal matters across 12 practice areas for clients ranging from Fortune 100 to SMBs, empowering our legal professionals to engage in meaningful work that advances their careers. Our Talent NPS score of +71% and our Client NPS score of +64% highlight our commitment to excellence ( Reported scores were Axiom’s average for 2025 – the legal industry average NPS score is +35% ). Join our forward-thinking community where you’ll keep your career dynamic and multi-faceted, be part of a company that values agility, collaboration, and excellence, and love both the law and your life. Learn more about life at Axiom . Axiom is the global leader in high-caliber, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in class alterative legal services. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c1f8333-7010-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will act as a technical subject matter expert, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable platform solutions. You will work directly with enterprise stakeholders to lead technical discovery, solution workshops, architecture, development, and implementation. Support reporting, dashboards, and Performance Analytics capabilities where required. Apply Agile/Scrum and DevOps principles to deliver solutions efficiently across multiple client engagements. Contribute to continuous platform improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize configurations, automate processes, and expand the value delivered through ServiceNow. Strong proficiency in ServiceNow scripting and development technologies, including JavaScript, GlideScript, Jelly, AngularJS, HTML, and CSS. Proven experience designing and implementing REST and SOAP integrations with third-party systems. Hands-on knowledge of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Import Sets, Transform Maps, MID Server, Update Sets, ServiceNow Studio, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). jobgether-jobgether:lever:5ee61e1e-3233-.title: SAP SD Solution Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5ee61e1e-3233-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP SD Solution Architect based in India. This is a senior architecture role focused on designing and delivering scalable SAP Sales & Distribution solutions across ECC and S/4HANA environments. You will work on development-intensive implementation and enhancement programs where SD capabilities continuously evolve through new features, change requests, and productized improvements. The role combines deep SAP SD expertise with strong knowledge of custom development, RICEFW, integrations, and clean-core-aligned extensibility. You will translate complex business needs into robust technical-functional designs and guide development teams through delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with ABAP, FI, MM, TM, EWM, and external system teams to build integrated end-to-end solutions. This is an opportunity to influence architecture, delivery standards, and long-term SAP transformation initiatives within a consulting environment. Own the solution architecture for SAP SD across development-heavy implementation, transformation, and enhancement programs. Translate business requirements into scalable technical-functional designs, balancing standard SAP capabilities with appropriate custom solutions. Design and govern SD custom developments, including pricing logic, user exits, BADIs, enhancements, complex order processing, and output determination using technologies such as BRF+, SmartForms, and Adobe Forms. Lead functional specification development and collaborate with ABAP teams on RICEFW objects, including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows. Guide the use of CDS views, OData services, Fiori applications, and custom UI extensions to expose and enhance SD capabilities. Define S/4HANA extensibility strategies, including in-app versus side-by-side extensions, clean-core principles, and the appropriate use of SAP BTP and CPI. Drive integration architecture across FI, MM, TM, EWM, and third-party platforms such as 3PL providers, tax engines, and CRM systems. Review development designs and code impacts from a functional perspective and participate in architecture, design, and peer reviews. Lead SIT and UAT activities for development objects, including defect triage, issue resolution, and performance optimization. Support enhancement roadmaps, change-request estimation, backlog prioritization, and Agile delivery processes. Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership while ensuring solutions remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. Requirements: 8–10 years of hands-on SAP SD experience, preferably with substantial exposure to development-intensive implementation and enhancement programs. Strong experience collaborating with ABAP teams on custom developments, enhancements, interfaces, and complex business requirements. Deep knowledge of SD exits, BADIs, pricing routines, custom logic, and enhancement frameworks. Strong understanding of integration patterns and technologies including IDocs, OData, REST APIs, and SAP CPI. Proven experience with S/4HANA SD transformations and designing clean-core-aligned custom extensions. Experience working within Big 4 or Tier-1 system integration consulting environments is preferred. Ability to operate as a functional architect for SAP SD development initiatives rather than focusing solely on configuration. Exposure to Fiori Elements, CDS-based analytics, SAP BRIM, Vistex, or complex pricing engines is advantageous. Experience with Agile or product-oriented delivery models is a plus. Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and business topics clearly. Strong influencing and stakeholder-management abilities, with confidence working across multidisciplinary teams

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:d3063f.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As enterprises integrate AI into critical workflows, they need to trust that the platforms they rely on are secure, compliant, and resilient. That's where you come in. We're hiring a Security Engineer to own Profound's security posture across our platform, infrastructure, and corporate environment. You'll be the first dedicated security hire, which means you'll shape how we approach access control, vulnerability management, compliance, and incident response from the ground up. You'll partner closely with our Engineering and Infrastructure teams to build practical, scalable security systems that protect customer data and enable rapid growth. This role is ideal for someone who sees security as a business accelerator, not a blocker, and who thrives on building rather than auditing. What you'll do In your first 90 days, you'll focus on our most pressing priorities: partnering with our Infrastructure team to harden our AWS environment, driving SOC 2 Type II continuous compliance (defining controls and closing gaps), and integrating security scanning into our CI/CD pipelines. Over time, you'll take on broader responsibility across our security posture: - Enforce least-privilege access controls and conduct regular access reviews across environments - Build and run a vulnerability management program spanning infrastructure, applications, and dependencies - Triage and respond to security findings from automated tooling, bug bounty programs, and third-party assessments - Partner with Infrastructure to implement detection and monitoring capabilities using log aggregation and SIEM tooling - Conduct risk assessments, maintain a risk register, and drive prioritization decisions - Build security policies and procedures that reflect how we actually operate - Lead post-incident reviews and drive systemic improvements Must have - 5+ years in security engineering, with experience in high-growth SaaS or infrastructure-heavy environments - Hands-on experience building or maintaining a SOC 2 compliance program - Strong knowledge of AWS security services and cloud security architecture (IAM, VPC, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub) - Deep understanding of identity and authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML, OIDC) - Practical scripting skills in Python or Bash for automating security workflows Strong plus - Experience integrating vulnerability management and security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) into CI/CD workflows - Familiarity with network security fundamentals (firewalls, DNS, VPNs, segmentation, traffic analysis) - Experience with infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform, CloudFormation) - Background in penetration testing, application security assessments, or CTF competitions - Familiarity with data infrastructure security for systems like ClickHouse or PostgreSQL - Experience with data processing compliance in analytics-heavy environments - Relevant certifications (CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or similar) Who you are - thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Keystone Urology - powered by Urology Alliance. As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), Keystone Urology is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers Keystone Urology to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our clinicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Job description Join the Dream Team at Keystone Urology! Ready to elevate your career? Keystone Urology in the greater Philadelphia area is growing, and we are seeking a new Physician Assistant to join our expanding clinic in Lancaster in 2026! Picture this: a fulfilling job, a beautiful community, and the bragging rights of being a hero in the world of urology. Why Join Keystone Urology? Elite Squad: Work alongside 9 full-time Urologists and 8 Advanced Practice Providers who will make you feel like part of a well-oiled machine. Balanced Schedule: Monday-Friday clinic hours with outpatient focus, plus an inpatient week every six weeks. Optional Weekend Call: 7 am to 11 am. Work those hours and still make brunch. Now that’s work-life balance. Discover Lancaster, PA: The Best of Both Worlds Nestled in the heart of Amish Country, Lancaster is a charming blend of horse-drawn buggies and Wi-Fi. It’s only about 70 miles from Philadelphia and 80 miles from Baltimore, so you’re close enough to the action but far enough to avoid the traffic headaches. Schools: From stellar public schools to private institutions with names fancy enough to impress anyone (we’re looking at you, Lancaster Country Day School), Lancaster has your kids covered. Cost of Living: You’ll love the affordability—the median home price is around $280,000! That’s a steal compared to Philly or Baltimore. Life Outside the Clinic Outdoor Adventures: Lancaster County Central Park, kayaking on the Conestoga River, and hikes with views so stunning you’ll wonder why you ever liked treadmills. Cultural Charm: Enjoy Broadway-caliber shows at the Fulton Theatre, fresh eats at Lancaster Central Market, and the occasional competitive whoopie pie bake-off (unofficial, but worth joining). Shopping & Dining: From boutique shops to big-name outlets, plus dining options that range from farm-to-table to "table filled with Amish baked goods." Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth.
